# Disagreement Log — 1 Kings Chapter 21
**Reviewed by:** SOPHIA | **Date:** 2026-03-11

---

## Summary
1 verse(s) flagged for significant translation divergence.

### Verse 1
**EMET (literal):** And-it-was after these things. A-vineyard was to-Naboth the-Jezreelite, that was in-Jezreel, beside the-palace-of Ahab king-of Samaria.

**LOGOS (formal):** Now Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard in Jezreel, beside the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
**2** And after this Ahab said to Naboth, "Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a vegetable garden, because it is near my house, and I will give you a better vineyard for it; or, if it seems good...

**PNEUMA (dynamic):** There was a man named Naboth from Jezreel who owned a vineyard next to the palace of King Ahab of Samaria.
**2** Ahab said to Naboth, "Let me have your vineyard so I can use it as a vegetable garden — it's right next to my palace. I'll give you a better vineyard in exchange, or if you prefer, I'll p...

**SOPHIA resolution:** The divergence reflects translation philosophy differences rather than disagreement about the Hebrew text. LOGOS adopted as consensus baseline.

---

— SOPHIA
